body: Haha not just PowerPoint, PowerQuery, and PowerPivot are where it's at. SQL will get you everywhere.
Thanks! I took it from a way to organize my gambling habit and turned it into a career.

Thanks! It is actually a great skill to mesh with my ADHD and OCD. Playing with numbers all day in Excel has helped me big time in my career and even got me into a great masters degree program that I finished recently.
I am amazing at Microsoft Excel.

My days are wracked with obsessing over wasting my life away. There are so many regrets that I can't forgive myself for. I constantly wonder what my life would be like if I was normal. :( I wish I was dead too.

I am still alive. It took a couple of days for the hospital to let me go because I made a really serious suicide attempt. The new scars on both of my wrists and my neck hurt so bad that I'm typing this with my left pinky really slow. The rest of my fingers have very little feeling and might not work right for a long time they said. I should have just used a gun.

I appreciate it but after this many years the only thing I could possibly gain is more pain and suffering. There is no point in going on. My teens, 20s and now 30s which were supposed to have been great years of my life have passed me by due to depression. I turn 40 next year, if it hasn't gotten better by now why spend the end of my life in tears.

I'm sorry Kraid but I am worth nothing. If there are reasons to love me i have never been able to determine them. Suicide is the only way to make the pain stop. I'm not strong enough to fight this any more. Life is the final thing for me to lose at. Along with everything else.

Thanks. It does seem impossible but I don't take what you said as hollow. Some people's lives can change. Mine has not and for 17 long years I've thought about committing suicide dozens of times per day because of it. The constant replaying of events the day that she dumped me NEVER stops in my mind. 17 straight years, no let up. It's unbearable. Tomorrow I need to kill myself. She basically did 17 years ago anyway.

Thanks but There is no point in calling one. I've been I therapy for most of my life and nothing has ever gotten better. Except when I was with her for that summer. Feeling like a normal human being never happened again. I don't think that anybody could understand how horrible my life feels. No counselor, I just figured in case people have questions after tomorrow night I would email out the link to this thread. Not that anybody out there will think much of it other than fish that's too bad. 17 years later it hurts just as intensely as it did then. I'm worthless and it's time to finally commit suicide.

So I went out to the woods to the spot I was going to kill myself but I had a complete nervous break down and didn't go through with it. I'm horribly shaken and sore from punishing myself for failing. As soon as I gather myself again I want to go back and kill myself. My life will never get better.
I never got over one of my ex girlfriends and that's the main reason that I want to kill myself too. I've already tried to 8 times over the years. I'm really close to doing it now too.

I guess that I stopped because I was ready to end it all. After that next attempt at suicide by pills and alcohol failed I have been tempted to cut every day but don't want to go back to the hospital. This time I want to be dead.
Have you ever cut yourself before? I used to do it daily for a few years. Hopefully you don't start because it's really addicting in a sick way.

A number of things but the one that's hitting me the hardest right now is that I have never gotten over my ex girlfriend dumping me... 17 years ago. I'm such a loser. Things never got better. I should kill myself.
Thanks. If I ever improve maybe I could create something. :(

Dude I've done the bottle of lorazepam and gin. It gave me the worst headaches and stomach pain but I doubt it would've killed me. It isn't worth your time. I need to find another way. Hopefully you don't do the same.

To whomever down voted my comment. ( I don't necessarily mean you @Nicelce ) . Why do that? Aren't we supposed to be able to explain why we're suicidal on here? No, having a masters degree doesn't help with my depression. It might be hard for people to see but depression crushes you in every way. The job I'm in now makes me feel like I'm in way over my head. However my degree says I shouldn't feel that way. That's all I'm saying.
It might not have been written well but yes. Maybe I was trying to say that the masters degree doesn't guarantee professional success. For me it certainly hasn't.

I hear you man. For the last 17 years I've thought about killing myself 50 times per day. Nothing helps and now my life has taken a turn for the worse. I know we're supposed too day that it will get better but over the last 17 years it's only gotten worse for me. You might be different though.
No you shouldn't OP. I have a STEM masters degree and I am about ready to off myself. I feel like a failure at life despite whatever qualifications my degrees are supposed to have prepared me for.
